<!-- entire-trail-link-end -->

## Why

There was no CLI front door for cloning an Entire-native repo — users had to hand-build the `entire://<clusterHost>/et/<project>/<repo>` URL.

## What

Run `entire clone /et/paul/dogbark` (or the `paul/dogbark` shorthand) to resolve the repo's home cluster via the control plane and clone it. `clone` is now also a top-level command — the same command as `repo clone` (the `search` precedent); it still takes `/gh/<owner>/<repo>` refs and raw `entire://` URLs.

The clone URL comes from `GetRepo`'s server-minted `clusterHost` + `path` (never synthesized, never with a `.git` suffix — the server strips that for `/gh/` only). `--cluster` is rejected on native refs: a native repo has one home cluster.

agent-help classification for top-level `clone`: user-owned, unlisted (safe default — promote if desired).

## Verification

`mise run check` green. Live: `entire clone /et/paul/dogbark` and `entire clone paul/dogbark` both cloned from `aws-ap-southeast-2.entire.io` (details in PR comment).

> **Medium Risk**
> New control-plane resolution and server-derived clone URLs affect how users fetch repos; behavior is covered by tests and reuses existing host validation, but mis-resolution or API errors would block clones.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds a **CLI path to clone Entire-native repos** without hand-building `entire://` URLs. **`entire clone`** (and **`entire repo clone`**) now accept **`/et/<project>/<repo>`** or **`project/repo`**, resolve the repo through the control plane (`GetRepo` for authoritative **`clusterHost` + `path`**), then run **`git clone`**. **`--cluster` is rejected** on native refs (home cluster only). Existing **`/gh/...`** mirror refs and passthrough **`entire://`** URLs are unchanged.
> 
> **`clone` is registered as a top-level Control Plane command** (same implementation as `repo clone`, with control-plane flags wired at root), following the **`search`** precedent; **`repo clone` remains an alias**.
> 
> Docs, **agent-help** (user-owned, unlisted), and **`.entire` dir check exemption** for top-level clone are updated; unit tests cover native ref parsing, URL resolution, and cluster-flag behavior.
